# GitHub Actions workflows

## `ci.yml`

Runs type checking, enforced unit coverage, Prisma 6 compatibility, Prisma 7 SQLite,
PostgreSQL and MariaDB integration tests, a production build, package metadata
normalization, audit, and tarball inspection.

Coverage fails below 90% statements, lines, or functions and below 80%
branches. The summary and browsable LCOV report are retained as CI artifacts.

## `release.yml`

Validates a version tag and publishes through npm trusted publishing. Configure
the npm trusted publisher with:

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Organization or user | `resilientmq` |
| Repository | `prisma-connector` |
| Workflow filename | `release.yml` |
| Environment | `npm` |
| Allowed action | `npm publish` |

The workflow requires `id-token: write`, npm 11.5.1 or newer, a GitHub-hosted
runner, and no npm publication token.

## First npm publication

npm cannot configure a trusted publisher before the package exists. Publish the
first version from a clean, merged `main` checkout using an npm account with
organization publish permission and two-factor authentication:

```bash
npm ci
npm run check
npm run test:coverage
npm audit --audit-level=high
npm login --auth-type=web
npm whoami
npm publish --access public --provenance=false
```

`--provenance=false` is required only for this local bootstrap because npm
provenance attestations are generated by the GitHub-hosted release workflow.
Do not create the `v0.1.0` Git tag after publishing it manually: the release
workflow correctly rejects versions that already exist. Configure the trusted
publisher, then use OIDC starting with the next package version and tag.

```bash
npm install --global npm@^11.15.0
npm login --auth-type=web
npm trust github @resilientmq/prisma-connector \
  --repo resilientmq/prisma-connector \
  --file release.yml \
  --env npm \
  --allow-publish
npm trust list @resilientmq/prisma-connector
```

After an OIDC release succeeds, set npm package publishing access to require
two-factor authentication and disallow tokens, then remove any obsolete
automation token.
